scope: R2 static sampling engineering only: exact conservative spherical broad phase and admitted independent sampling batches; no new rheology, dynamics, reference acquisition or full-world run
scientific_policy: The original precursor_r2.json and all its numerical tolerances remain unchanged. No truncation, snapping, precision downgrade or approximate cell means.

spherical_index.cap: local hemispherical vertex-mean cap, conditioned chart-centre fallback; encloses complete minor arcs and interiors
spherical_index.bounds: unit-sphere Cartesian chord balls; 2D STRtree plus third-coordinate and angular filtering
spherical_index.roundoff_guard: 512*binary64_epsilon, outward enclosure arithmetic only; not changed area acceptance tolerance
spherical_index.exact_stage: retained spherical overlays and compatible-chart refusals; uncertain candidate retained
spherical_index.repeated_support: one cap per unique footprint; disjoint vertical intervals swept before one exact overlay per footprint pair
spherical_index.worst_case: dense overlapping caps remain quadratic; explicit work admission and cancellation retained

execution_defaults.cell_auto: serial; finite tested cell cases were slower with threads
execution_defaults.explicit_comparisons: serial/threads; optional explicitly selected cell count threshold
execution_defaults.workers: existing ExecutionPolicy default min(2, available CPUs)
execution_defaults.processes: refused for shared prepared native indices

execution_integrity: complete-request overlap and unique-ID validation before any workers
global sparse-row/work/geometry-hit ledgers across every batch
captured immutable inputs, ordered outputs, translated sparse row/phase offsets
parent admission holds complete jobs; detached children account suballocations without double charging
aggregate retention and merge reservation; cancellation drains jobs before memory is released
source/runtime and loaded-callable verification before/after complete request
same current scientific sample identity for serial and threaded route; execution configuration excluded
existing lossless Zstd/Blosc2 snapshots and deduplication

verification_families.PT01-PT02: bounded batching, ordering and matched-work execution
verification_families.PT03-PT06: global resource limits, immutable inputs and invalidation
verification_families.PT09-PT11: cancel, drain, reuse and exact restore
verification_families.PT13-PT14: finite Linux evidence with first/reused complete-call timings

acceptance: all retained and new functional tests; exact serial/thread array identities; identical overlap result; unchanged source inventory; no leaked admissions; timing is descriptive only
